Forty newly listed Simulation dossiers reuse existing conventional fire/clip mechanics and family budgets. They do not constitute forty new original mechanics or newly granted campaign weapons.
The common carrier budget and equipment capacities/reserves are ATB adaptation values, not official original weapon statistics, ranks or balancing.

Native single-order shots do not fully reproduce a model’s automatic/burst sequence, shotgun spread, range, zoom, penetration, recoil, sound, animation or geometry; per-model limitations remain visible.

All selected profiles are standard and already supported. Unconfigured editions, research/class restrictions, local heavy weapons, heat weapons, charge/beam models and foreign-work homonyms were deliberately excluded.
This module grants no named character equipment, scenario eligibility, acquisition, research, stock, economy, powers or multiplayer variants.
Existing catalogue bibliography is preserved without a new external or primary-source claim; source presence alone does not certify every original model property.
Parent-owned root service, UI/browser, persistence and production checks are outside this targeted report and require their own evidence.
